title: Settings
autoReconnect: Reconnect automatically when a tunnel drops
keepaliveTooltip: Seconds between keepalive pings so a dead connection gets noticed. 0 disables keepalives.
retriesTooltip: Give up reconnecting after this many consecutive failed attempts. 0 means never give up.
portMinTooltip: Lower bound of the local SOCKS port range suggested when adding a new tunnel.
portMaxTooltip: Upper bound of the local SOCKS port range suggested when adding a new tunnel.
hyprlandAutostart: Hyprland ignores the autostart entry this writes. Add this to ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.conf instead:
updatedByPackageManager: Updates come from your package manager.

preferences.title: Theme
preferences.hint: Changes apply instantly — hover a theme to preview it on the window.

themeSlotLiveHint: Your system is in this mode right now, so this is the theme on screen.
themeDormantHint: You are editing the {{slot}} theme, but your system is {{live}} right now — picks here show up once it switches.
themeDormantSaved: Saved {{name}} for {{slot}} mode. Your system is {{live}} right now, so the window keeps its current theme.
terminalAppMouse: Let programs on the server use the terminal's mouse
terminalAppMouseHint: For tmux (mouse on), vim, htop, mc. While they have it, selecting text needs Shift+drag. Off: dragging always selects and copies.

tunnels.title: Tunnels
tunnels.description: How tunnels stay connected, and defaults for new ones.

backup.title: Backup
backup.description: Move tunnels, rules and settings to another machine, or keep a copy.

devtools.title: Developer tools
devtools.description: Fake update states and tunnel failures for testing.

runAtStartupHint: Opens protunel when you sign in to your computer.
startMinimizedHint: At sign-in, stay in the tray instead of opening the window. Opening protunel yourself always shows it.
showNotificationsHint: When a tunnel connects, drops or gives up reconnecting.
portRangeHint: Local SOCKS ports suggested when you add a tunnel; the first free one is used.
knownHostsHint: Servers whose host key you have trusted. A changed key is flagged on the tunnel itself.
autoReconnectHint: Retries with a growing delay when a tunnel's SSH session drops.
terminalWebglHint: Faster with heavy output. Turn off for the system's own text rendering, often sharper on standard-DPI screens.
tagline: SSH tunnels, SOCKS routing and terminals in one tray app.
license: Free software under the GPL-3.0 licence.
updateReady: Version {{version}} is downloaded and ready to install
autoUpdateHint: protunel checks every few hours and downloads in the background; you choose when to restart.
autoUpdateHintExit: protunel checks every few hours and downloads in the background; a ready update installs when you quit, or restart now.

mode.title: Interface
mode.simpleHint: One Internal network switch; tunnels can't be changed in this mode.
mode.fullHint: Everything: tunnels, router rules, terminal, capture.

terminalSuggestionsHint: Suggests as you type: the rest of a command you have run on this host (→ takes it, Ctrl+→ one word), the commands you usually start with, and a fix after common errors (Alt+Enter puts it at the prompt; nothing runs by itself). Kept on this computer only, never exported. Lines starting with a space or looking like a password are skipped.
terminalLongCommand: Notify when a long command finishes
terminalLongCommandHint: Seconds a command must run before its end raises a notification, if you are looking elsewhere. 0 turns it off.
terminalForgetHint: Clears what was learned on every host. Workspaces stay.
